symptoms_en: Yellow spots and yellowing, leaves curl downward and dry; sooty mould on the leaves; it carries tomato leaf curl and okra yellow vein mosaic viruses.
symptoms_hi: पीले धब्बे और पीलापन, पत्तियाँ नीचे की ओर मुड़कर सूखती हैं; पत्तियों पर कालिख जैसी फफूँद; यह टमाटर लीफ कर्ल और भिंडी पीला शिरा मोज़ेक विषाणु फैलाती है।

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of tomato
management_en.quote: Install yellow sticky traps @ 12 /ha to attract the adult. Remove alternate weed host Abutilon indicum. Uproot and destroy the diseased leaf curl plants Use nitrogen and irrigation judiciously.

management_en: Install yellow sticky traps (12 per hectare). Remove the weed host Abutilon indicum. Uproot and destroy leaf-curl plants. Use nitrogen and irrigation sensibly.
